title: Interior Design Visual Communication
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Interior Design Visual Communication - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Communicate an interior design effectively through visual means by applying elements and principles of design with the use of manual and computer presentation techniques to express design ideas, and concepts in relation to interior design projects.
Solve interior design problems by evaluating designs pertaining to space planning and lighting of interior design projects and providing plausible solutions

Identify and apply social, ethical and cultural responsibility to the health, safety, and welfare of society and community through the study and application of current codes and building systems as they relate to interior design projects.

Achieve a level of technical and design knowledge appropriate for career advancement as a support personnel in various design industries and set career goals for future advancement in the interior design industry.

blocks.name: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement (CA)

notes: The catalog prints the internship as a single row 'ID 482ABCD Internships in Interior Design 1.00 - 4.00'. It is recorded as one required slot: ID 482A, with ID 482B, ID 482C and ID 482D as alternatives. The individual units (1, 2, 3, 4) come from the closed list, since the catalog prints only the 1.00-4.00 range. A reviewer should confirm that the student takes one level, or a combination totaling 1-4 units.
ID 21 (Space Planning) and ID 27 (Computer Drafting & Design for Interiors) are required in the catalog but are absent from the closed list, so they are marked catalog_addition true.
Careers 'Interior Design', 'Architecture' and 'Engineering' are taken from the phrase 'production of presentations for Interior Design, Architecture and Engineering fields' in the description.
